visual_palette_and_lighting: Deep shadows, candlelit interiors, cold moonlight contrasting with warm hearths, and an oppressive palette of midnight blues, blood reds, and sepia tones.
narrative_tone_progression: Begins with a disorienting sense of isolated unease and strange folklore, shifts into intellectual bewilderment and empathetic comfort, and finally accelerates into a high-stakes, breathless hunt defined by grim determination and impending dawn.
